name: Camping Seespitz Walchsee
beschreibung: Camping Seespitz Walchsee is located directly on Walchsee in the district of Kufstein. The site comprises spacious pitches for caravans and motorhomes. A private swimming beach with sunbathing lawn and jetty is available. Guests have access to a heated outdoor pool. In the immediate surroundings, there are opportunities for sailing and surfing. The site is equally suitable for families and nature lovers.
